summary: Magnus pins Ardent 3.6.0: node agents stage Ardent 3.6.0 for managed profiles, and the generated Ardent client types follow its readiness change (a 503 from GET /health/ready now says status not_ready instead of degraded; memory status still says degraded). Ardent 3.6.0's retention options are configuration only, so no node agent allowlist changes. No Magnus code, setting or migration changes.
